== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 6 October 2016. The Facebook photo viewer names Jan Koevoets. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 116 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Etten-Leur, Neth). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/jan.koevoets.90. The uncropped original is a two-person photograph; the lead crop is Koevoets alone (the man on the right).
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jan Koevoets portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jan Koevoets Facebook portrait.jpg]].
